intro: People you share this document with can read it, but never change it. A share works only while you can open the document yourself.
untilHint: Optional. Access ends at the end of this day (server time); leave it empty for no end date.
withdrawBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to open this document through this share. This cannot be undone.
lapsed: The person who shared this document with you can no longer open it, so your access has ended.

error.duplicate: It is already shared with this person.
error.invalid: The server rejected the request. Check the end date.
error.untilPast: The end date cannot be in the past.
error.rateLimited: You are sharing too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
error.notFound: This document or person no longer exists.
error.withdrawFailed: Withdrawing the share failed. Try again.

page.title: Shared
page.description: Documents shared with you, and the ones you shared with others.
page.withMeHint: Documents other people shared with you. You can read them, but not change them.
page.byMeHint: Documents you shared with others. You can withdraw an active share at any time.
page.noWithMe: Nothing has been shared with you.
